bio.text: Jessica Caloza was sworn into the California State Assembly in December 2024 and represents the 52nd Assembly District, which includes East Los Angeles, Northeast Los Angeles and South Glendale.

She worked on education policy in the Obama administration, was appointed to the Los Angeles Board of Public Works in 2019, and later served as deputy chief of staff to the Attorney General at the California Department of Justice.
Caloza graduated from the University of California, San Diego, and is the first Filipina elected to the California State Legislature, according to her official biography.
